record.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
record.description:
A racing game spanning France and Japan with more than 40 licensed cars, dozens of tracks, a Japanese car-culture story mode, highway traffic races, and extensive mechanical and cosmetic customization.

The career mode moves between France and Japan, emphasizing regional racing cultures and event identity. Japanese roads, tuning culture and vehicle style are especially important to this entry. Progression is built around unlocking faster cars, tougher events and deeper customization options. The overall structure mixes collection, customization and racing progression rather than a character-heavy narrative.

record.title: GRID Legends: Deluxe Edition
record.description:
Codemasters' circuit racer arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 in a complete Deluxe Edition with the Driven to Glory story, a large career mode, event creator, and the released DLC package.

Driven to Glory adds a live-action documentary-style narrative layer to the racing structure. Outside of the story mode, the larger career spans many disciplines, classes and event types. The Deluxe package broadens the value proposition through included content and long-term progression. The overall experience emphasizes variety, speed and technical flexibility on Switch 2.

record.worldSummary: Driven to Glory adds a live-action documentary-style narrative layer to the racing structure. Outside of the story mode, the larger career spans many disciplines, classes and event types. The Deluxe package broadens the value proposition through included content and long-term progression. The overall experience emphasizes variety, speed and technical flexibility on Switch 2.

record.studioAbout: CAPCOM is the Japanese developer and publisher behind Monster Hunter, Resident Evil and Street Fighter. Monster Hunter Stories 3 extends the turn-based Monster Rider RPG branch with redesigned character presentation, larger environments, a new story and expanded customization.
